content: Two auxiliary views are included to improve the model. The first view is generated from a recurrent representation vector INLINEFORM0 to acquire the local probability distribution INLINEFORM1 , where INLINEFORM2 . The second view is generated from the low-level distant representation vectors INLINEFORM3 to acquire the probability distribution of a distant structure in the low-level module INLINEFORM4 , where INLINEFORM5 . By generating the views from these representation vectors separately, the local and distant structures in the low-level module can improve equally.
